At a family gathering, Meng Hua's cousin asks him if he believes in the real existence of Santa Claus. Meng Hua does not want to break his cousin's fantasy, so he says: "Of course, Santa Claus is real!"

[Question]

D. Meng Hua convinces his cousin because he does not want to shatter his illusion.
